reason: Issue 246 adds agent V9 generation-fenced extraction and V10 durable resource ingestion jobs/cursors, plus media V4 extraction outcomes and source-event/scope metadata. Older writers can bypass the generation fence or omit ingestion events, so downgrade to epoch 5 is forbidden. Epoch 5 already requires the issue 245 transactional outboxes and projection cursors; epoch 4 private resource lifecycle and terminal deletion markers; epoch 3 versioned password hashes; epoch 2 durable sessions. Restore media and agent databases, durable cursors and private objects consistently. Rollback never reverses SQL or changes persistence images.
